name: GITGE Sipopo Datacenter
developer: GITGE (Gestor de Infraestructuras de Telecomunicaciones de Guinea Ecuatorial)
notes: Flagship in-country colocation (coubicacion) facility at Carretera Malabo-Sipopo, Bioko Norte (Insular). GITGE official colocation service page + 2024 annual report confirm the service exists (A); PeeringDB fac 9041 / AS37529 (updated 2025-09-26) and DataCenterMap supply Sipopo identity and address (C). Capacity, Tier and rack counts not officially published - directory-only values remain C. Do not assume identity with the planned 8-cable national DC.

name: Centro de Datos de la Administracion (CNIAPGE), Malabo II
developer: CNIAPGE (Centro Nacional para la Informatizacion de la Administracion Publica, under Presidencia del Gobierno)
notes: Government administration data center in Malabo II, Bioko Norte (Insular): 2014-07-12 public tender for passive/active data-center equipment (A), inaugurated 2016-06-04 (A), 2025 board record of equipment renewal and data custody/continuity mandate (A). guineainfomarket profile claims CNIAPGE runs a Tier III data center (C - no Uptime confirmation). Capacity not public; keep separate from GITGE Sipopo.

name: PAMFP / Hacienda Principal Data Center (Malabo)
developer: Ministerio de Hacienda, Planificacion y Desarrollo Economico / PAMFP (AfDB co-financed)
notes: PAMFP national tender (2026-06-04) to equip the Finance Ministry principal data center (Centro de Datos Principal) in Malabo, lot 1, 4-month execution, solar equipment. Programme existence A (PAMFP/AfDB); lot specifics B (trade coverage ecofinge/EquaCom). Tender-stage only; verify whether an existing ministry server room is being modernized. No award/inauguration evidence.

name: SEGESA / Minsait internal data center (Malabo)
notes: SEGESA electricity-company transformation contract (~EUR 5m) includes supply of a new internal data center in Malabo (and Bata) per Minsait/Indra official press release (B - vendor contract scope). Operator-internal utility facility, not public colocation; no commissioning evidence found. Do not merge with PAMFP/Hacienda or CNIAPGE.

name: Planned national data center (capacity for 8 submarine cables)
notes: Official press: GITGE presented a national data-center project with capacity for 8 submarine cables to attract operators such as Google; Vice-Presidency gave go-ahead pending public tender. Division unconfirmed (presented in Malabo, likely Malabo/Sipopo area) - recorded under Insular with location uncertainty. Planned only; no award/construction/commissioning evidence. Keep separate from Sipopo DC and from the Annobon fiber project.

name: Nigeria-BCN commercial data center (agreement)
developer: Backbone Connectivity Network (BCN) / Government of Equatorial Guinea
notes: Strategic agreement (2026-02-08) between the GQ Government and Nigerian BCN (Backbone Connectivity Network, Ibrahim Dikko) covering a submarine fiber cable and construction of a commercial data center. Agreement-level evidence only (official press A / AhoraEG B); division/site unconfirmed (likely Malabo; recorded under Insular with uncertainty). Do not promote to construction without site/tender evidence.

name: PAMFP / Hacienda Backup Data Center (Bata)
developer: Ministerio de Hacienda, Planificacion y Desarrollo Economico / PAMFP (AfDB co-financed)
notes: Lot 2 of the PAMFP 2026-06 tender equips the Finance Ministry backup data center (Centro de Datos de Respaldo) in Bata, Litoral (Continental) - the strongest Continental-division datacenter lead. 4-month execution, solar equipment, national tender. Tender-stage; no award evidence. Do not count the ACE landing station or GITGE Bata technical rooms as this facility.

name: SEGESA / Minsait internal data center (Bata)
notes: Bata component of the SEGESA transformation contract's new data-center supply (Minsait/Indra official release 2019-01-15, ~EUR 5m total contract). Utility-internal facility lead on the mainland; no acceptance/commissioning evidence. Do not merge with the PAMFP/Hacienda Bata backup DC. No other Continental (Rio Muni) colocation evidence found in this round.
